info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_P2M Refund Management API
info.description: The P2M Refund Management API facilitates the seamless processing of refund requests for payment transactions. This API allows businesses to initiate refunds quickly, ensuring customer satisfaction and efficient transaction handling. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial service providers who need to manage refund operations. By offering robust functionality for refund processing, this API helps maintain smooth customer service and accountability in financial transactions.

post.description: This operation allows users to initiate a refund for a specific transaction, providing the necessary details to process the request. Ensure all required fields are filled out to prevent delays in processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund operation. The JSON object should contain relevant details about the transaction that is being refunded, including identifiers, amounts, and any necessary reason codes.

reason.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for the refund.

merchantRefundReference.description: Reference ID for the refund provided by the merchant.

requestContext.description: Context information related to the refund request.

currency.description: The currency of the amount being refunded.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses bearer authentication. It accepts a JWT (JSON Web Token) in the Authorization header to authenticate requests. The token must be prefixed with 'Bearer ' followed by a space.
